pairs: Misit igitur Josue filius Nun de Setim duos viros exploratores in abscondito:
sent two men from Shittim to explore in secret.
“Go and consider the land and the city of Jericho.”
Qui pergentes ingressi sunt domum mulieris meretricis,
they entered into the house of a harlot woman named Rahab,
And it was reported to the king of Jericho,
Ecce viri ingressi sunt huc per noctem de filiis Israël,
“Behold, men have entered to this place in the night, from the sons of Israel,
so that they might explore the land.”
And the king of Jericho sent to Rahab,
Educ viros, qui venerunt ad te,
“Bring out the men who came to you,
and who entered into your house.
and they have arrived to consider the entire land.”
“I admit that they came to me,
but I did not know where they were from.
And when the gate was closed,
they went out together in the darkness.
I do not know where they have gone.
Ipsa autem fecit ascendere viros in solarium domus suæ,
But she caused the men to ascend to the roof of her house,
operuitque eos stipula lini, quæ ibi erat.
and she covered them with the stalks of flax that were there.
Hi autem, qui missi fuerant, secuti sunt eos per viam, quæ ducit ad vadum Jordanis: illisque egressis statim porta clausa est.
But those who had been sent pursued after them along the way that leads to the ford of the Jordan. And as soon as they went out, the gate was closed.
Those who were hiding had not yet fallen asleep,
et ecce mulier ascendit ad eos,
and behold, the woman went up to them,
Novi quod Dominus tradiderit vobis terram:
“I know that the Lord has given this land to you.
etenim irruit in nos terror vester,
For the terror of you has fallen upon us,
and all the inhabitants of the land have languished.
Audivimus quod siccaverit Dominus aquas maris Rubri ad vestrum introitum,
We have heard that the Lord dried up the water of the Red Sea upon your arrival,
when you were departing from Egypt,
et quæ feceritis duobus Amorrhæorum regibus,
and we heard of the things that you did to the two kings of the Amorites,
nec remansit in nobis spiritus ad introitum vestrum:
Dominus enim Deus vester ipse est Deus in cælo sursum
Neither did there remain in us any spirit at your arrival.
For the Lord your God is the very God in heaven above and on earth below.
Nunc ergo jurate mihi per Dominum,
ut quomodo ego misericordiam feci vobiscum,
swear to me by the Lord that in the same way that I have acted with mercy toward you,
et vos faciatis cum domo patris mei:
so also shall you act toward the house of my father.
And may you give me a true sign
ut salvetis patrem meum et matrem,
that you will save my father and mother,
et eruatis animas nostras a morte.
and that you may rescue our souls from death.”
Anima nostra sit pro vobis in mortem,
“May our lives be yours unto death,
if only you do not betray us.
And when the Lord will have delivered the land to us,
faciemus in te misericordiam et veritatem.
we will act toward you with mercy and truth.”
Demisit ergo eos per funem de fenestra:
Therefore, she sent them down from a window with a rope.
For her house was joined to the wall.
otherwise, they may meet you as they are returning.
And lay hidden there for three days,
et sic ibitis per viam vestram.
And then you will go on your way.”
“We shall be innocent of this oath,
to which you have sworn us,
if, when we enter into the land,
this scarlet cord has been placed as a sign,
et ligaveris eum in fenestra, per quam demisisti nos:
and you have tied it at the window by which you let us down.
fratresque et omnem cognationem tuam congregaveris in domum tuam.
and mother, and brothers, and all your family into your house.
Qui ostium domus tuæ egressus fuerit,
Whoever will have exited from the door of your house,
sanguis ipsius erit in caput ejus,
his blood will be on his own head,
Cunctorum autem sanguis, qui tecum in domo fuerint, redundabit in caput nostrum,
But the blood of all who will be with you in the house shall fall back upon our own head,
But if you will have betrayed us,
et sermonem istum proferre in medium,
so that you spread this word in their midst,
we will be free from this oath,
to which you have sworn us.”
And sending them to travel on,
she hung the scarlet cord at the window.
Illi vero ambulantes pervenerunt ad montana,
And truly, walking on, they arrived at the mountains,
and they stayed there for three days,
until those who had been pursuing them returned.
For having sought them along the entire way,
the explorers descended from the mountain.
narraveruntque ei omnia quæ acciderant sibi,
and they reported to him all that had happened to them.
Tradidit Dominus omnem terram hanc in manus nostras,
“The Lord has delivered this entire land into our hands,
et timore prostrati sunt cuncti habitatores ejus.
and all its inhabitants have been struck down by fear.”
